title: Why Template Engines Still Matter
author: Jamie Lee
excerpt: Not every app needs a frontend framework. Template engines like Nunjucks keep things simple when your UI does not need to be highly dynamic.

title: Sharing Layouts with Template Inheritance
author: Priya Nair
excerpt: A base template plus a couple of named blocks is all it takes to stop copy-pasting headers and footers across every page.

title: Building Reusable Cards with Macros
author: Tom Becker
excerpt: Macros behave like functions for your markup: define the HTML once, call it with different data wherever you need it.
